what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted to recommend changes to the free cash policy language to the Board of Selectmen.
The town accountant described a strong FY18 free cash result and the idea of paying for the ladder truck with free cash rather than borrowing.
A member presented a five-year capital forecast and a property condition assessment recommending remediation to six buildings and demolition of the old primary school.
A resident argued the charter's 30-day window has passed, so the committee must fill its own vacancy; the Monday meeting stays as posted pending a town counsel check.
The next meeting was set for September 13th.

why_it_matters: Using free cash for the ladder truck instead of borrowing would avoid interest costs, but it uses money that could otherwise go to other needs or reduce taxes in later years.
The building assessment and five-year capital requests point to large future spending on town buildings that residents may be asked to approve at Town Meeting.
watch_next: The Board of Selectmen's response to the free cash policy recommendation.
Town counsel's answer on how the committee vacancy must be filled, and the committee's September 13th meeting.
